name: Exp_ADXDMI
summary: This EA trades based on the ADXDMI custom indicator, which appears to be an ADX/DMI-based trend following system with signal line crossovers. It opens buy positions when the indicator line crosses above the signal line and sell positions on the opposite crossover, with configurable stop loss and take profit levels.
summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义ADXDMI指标进行交易，属于ADX/DMI趋势跟踪系统，通过指标线与信号线的交叉来产生交易信号。当指标线上穿信号线时开多仓，下穿时开空仓，并设有可配置的止损和止盈。
strategy_analysis: 该EA采用基于ADXDMI指标的趋势跟踪策略，核心逻辑是指标线(Ind)与信号线(Sign)的交叉判断。入场条件为：当上一根K线的Ind大于Sign（即处于上升趋势中），且前一根K线的Ind小于等于Sign（即刚刚发生金叉）时，开多仓；反之当Ind下穿Sign时开空仓。出场条件通过独立的买卖平仓开关控制，当趋势反转信号出现时平掉反向仓位。仓位管理使用TradeAlgorithms.mqh库中的MarginMode枚举，支持按自由保证金、余额、扣除亏损后的余额等比例下单，也支持固定手数。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，默认0.1，MMMode默认为LOT（固定手数）。止损设为1000点，止盈设为2000点，盈亏比为2:1。EA使用IsNewBar机制确保每个K线只计算一次信号，避免重复开仓，同时通过SignalBar参数可选择使用哪根K线的信号。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA employs a trend following strategy based on the custom ADXDMI indicator, with the core logic centered on crossover signals between the indicator line (Ind) and the signal line (Sign). Entry conditions: when the previous bar's Ind is above Sign (confirming an uptrend) and the bar before that had Ind below or equal to Sign (a fresh golden cross), a buy position is opened; conversely, when Ind crosses below Sign, a sell position is opened. Exit conditions are handled through independent buy/sell close flags that trigger when the trend reverses, closing the opposing position. Position sizing leverages the TradeAlgorithms.mqh library's MarginMode enumeration, supporting lot sizing based on free margin, balance, balance minus floating loss, or fixed lot size. Money management is controlled by the MM parameter (default 0.1) with MMMode defaulting to LOT (fixed lot). Stop loss is set to 1000 points and take profit to 2000 points, yielding a 2:1 reward-to-risk ratio. The EA uses the IsNewBar mechanism to ensure signals are calculated only once per bar, preventing duplicate entries, and the SignalBar parameter allows selecting which bar's signal to use for execution.

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 保证金模式：自由保证金/余额/扣除亏损余额/固定手数

parameters.name: Deviation_
parameters.description_en: Maximum price deviation in points (slippage tolerance)

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 用于信号判断的K线索引

pros: 使用IsNewBar机制避免同一K线重复计算和重复开仓，逻辑严谨
提供灵活的资金管理模式，支持多种保证金计算方式
买卖开仓和平仓均可独立开关控制，灵活性高
止损止盈设置合理，盈亏比2:1有利于长期正期望
指标句柄检查和BarsCalculated验证确保数据完整性
pros_en: Uses IsNewBar mechanism to prevent duplicate signal calculation and duplicate entries on the same bar, ensuring robust logic
Provides flexible money management modes supporting multiple margin calculation methods
Buy/sell open and close operations can be independently toggled, offering high flexibility
Stop loss and take profit settings are reasonable with a 2:1 reward-to-risk ratio favoring long-term positive expectancy
Indicator handle validation and BarsCalculated check ensure data integrity before processing
cons: 依赖自定义ADXDMI指标，该指标代码未包含在内，无法独立验证其逻辑
止损1000点和止盈2000点数值偏大，在某些品种上可能不合适且未考虑ATR动态调整
没有对现有持仓进行检查，可能在已有同方向仓位时重复开仓
没有点差过滤，在高点差环境下可能产生不利成交
编码中存在乱码（俄文注释未正确显示），影响代码可读性和维护性
cons_en: Depends on a custom ADXDMI indicator whose source code is not included, making independent verification of its logic impossible
Stop loss of 1000 points and take profit of 2000 points are large fixed values that may not suit all instruments and lack ATR-based dynamic adjustment
No check for existing positions before opening new ones, which could lead to duplicate same-direction entries
No spread filter, potentially resulting in unfavorable fills in high-spread environments
Source code contains garbled text (Russian comments not displaying correctly), hurting readability and maintainability
improvements: 增加持仓检查逻辑，避免在已有同方向仓位时重复开仓
将止损止盈改为基于ATR的动态计算，适应不同品种的波动特性
增加点差过滤机制，在点差过大时暂停开仓以保护交易质量
improvements_en: Add position checking logic to avoid duplicate same-direction entries when a position already exists
Change stop loss and take profit to ATR-based dynamic calculation to adapt to different instruments' volatility characteristics
Add a spread filter mechanism to pause opening new positions when the spread is too wide, protecting trade execution quality

risk_points: 未检查现有持仓可能导致同方向重复开仓，放大风险敞口
固定止损止盈点数不适应所有品种的波动特性，可能在低波动品种上止损过宽
依赖外部自定义指标，若指标计算异常可能导致错误信号
risk_points_en: No existing position check may cause duplicate same-direction entries, amplifying risk exposure
Fixed stop loss and take profit points do not adapt to all instruments' volatility, potentially being too wide for low-volatility pairs
Dependency on an external custom indicator means abnormal indicator calculations could produce erroneous signals
